name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Requires Bachelor's degree with excellent academic records (GPA 3.5+ recommended), IELTS 7.0+, and strong leadership potential. For non-US citizens.
description: The Fulbright program covers full tuition, textbooks, round-trip airfare, a living stipend, and health insurance for postgraduate studies in any fields.

name: Chevening Scholarships
eligibility: Requires a minimum of two years' work experience, a completed undergraduate degree, and dynamic leadership skills. For students targeting Master's in the UK.
description: Funded by the UK Foreign Office, this scholarship covers full university tuition fees, a monthly living allowance, return flights, and grant support.

name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
eligibility: Requires a Bachelor's degree (completed within past 6 years), at least 2 years of professional work experience, GPA 3.0+, and IELTS 6.5+.
description: DAAD supports international students targeting Master's or PhD programs at state-recognized German universities, covering living expenses and travel.

name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
eligibility: Requires citizenship or refugee status in a Commonwealth country, high academic standing (GPA 3.5+), and inability to afford studying in the UK.
description: Commonwealth Scholarships are intended for talented individuals with the potential to make a positive impact on the global stage.

name: Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS)
eligibility: Requires full-time registration in a graduate studies program in Ontario, high GPA (typically A- or 3.7+ over last 2 years), and study permit.
description: Jointly funded by the Province of Ontario and participating universities to support merit-based graduate studies.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships
eligibility: For citizens of eligible countries in Asia, the Pacific, and Africa. Requires IELTS 6.5+ and commit to returning home to contribute to development.
description: Administered by the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) to promote development through education, covering full tuition and living expenses.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarship
eligibility: Requires a Bachelor's degree, excellent academic standing (GPA 3.6+), and willingness to study in at least two different European countries.
description: A prestigious, integrated study program covering full tuition fees, travel costs, installation allowances, and a generous monthly stipend.

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
eligibility: For outstanding applicants outside the UK applying for full-time postgraduate study at the University of Cambridge. Requires outstanding GPA (3.9+).
description: Covers the full cost of studying at Cambridge, including university fees, maintenance allowances, return airfare, and academic funding.

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
eligibility: Open to all nationalities targeting graduate degrees at Stanford University. Requires superior GPA, critical thinking, and civic leadership.
description: Full funding covering tuition, living expenses, books, academic materials, local transport, and global travel allowances at Stanford.

name: Great Scholarships
eligibility: For students from eligible countries targeting Master's programs at participating UK universities. Requires high academic record.
description: Covers tuition fees for one-year postgraduate courses in the UK, funded by the UK Government's GREAT Britain Campaign.
